leave_behind: hauska-engine-api has no CI/CD deploy workflow (no GitHub Actions step, no Cloud Build trigger) -- this mount was applied by a direct `gcloud run services update`, which is what the fleet rule 'the mount goes in the workflow, not by hand' explicitly wants to avoid. Worth a guard or a real workflow.
